strings.name: Rosalía
strings.summary: Trained in flamenco, Rosalía first worked with Raül Refree before connecting traditional singing with pop production on El Mal Querer. Motomami pursued fragmented rhythmic experiments, while Lux introduced orchestral arrangements and multilingual singing. Her work widened the international reach of Spanish music and prompted debate about tradition, identity and cultural borrowing.

strings.influence.rationale: Combines flamenco, pop and electronic music, reshaping traditional expression through works including El Mal Querer.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Grew up in Sant Esteve Sesrovires, Catalonia, Spain.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied at Taller de Músics and graduated from the Catalonia College of Music in 2017.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Reworking tradition
strings.highlights.h1.text: El Mal Querer combines flamenco singing with contemporary pop and electronic production.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Multilingual orchestral work
strings.highlights.h2.text: Lux brings the London Symphony Orchestra and guest singers into experiments with sound and language.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Lux wins album of the year
strings.timeline.t1.text: Performed at the Latin Grammys and won album of the year for Lux.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Released Lux
strings.timeline.t2.text: Her fourth studio album combined orchestration, multilingual lyrics and themes drawn from female saints.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released Motomami
strings.timeline.t3.text: Explored pop production through reggaeton, electronics and sonic collage.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Won a Grammy
strings.timeline.t4.text: El Mal Querer won best Latin rock, urban or alternative album.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Con Altura reaches audiences
strings.timeline.t5.text: Collaborated with J Balvin and El Guincho, expanding her global urban-pop audience.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Released El Mal Querer
strings.timeline.t6.text: Connected flamenco tradition with new rhythmic and visual language in a concept album.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Debut album and graduation
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released Los Ángeles with Raül Refree and completed her higher musical studies.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Recorded with Kejaleo
strings.timeline.t8.text: Sang on Alaire, gaining experience in released recordings and live performance.
